description.text: Clinical Practice in Internal Medicine of TCM, Surgery of TCM, Gynecology of TCM, Pediatrics of TCM, Dermatology of TCM, Orthopedics of TCM, Acupuncture, Tuina, etc.

duration.text: The Clinical Studies of TCM at Changchun University of Chinese Medicine is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/In total ￥ 20000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Licensed physicians of Chinese or Western medicine, acupuncturist, or senior students or graduates of medical schools, those who are interested in Chinese medicine could apply for short-term courses; Healthy
